args.title: Retail Returns Logistics — Combined Summary (Ironbark blog + companion)
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/returns and its companion piece (https://insights.ironbark.example/returns/companion):

• Apparel return rates reached 24%, underscoring the scale of the retail returns challenge.
• Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
• Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
